meta.title: Reverse auction where every price drop needs approval
gaps: Configure or verify the company setting that requires approval for every reverse-auction price decrease.
Approve the vendor's pending bid revision with a buyer remark.
Verify rank changes against competing vendors because the prepared state has only one vendor bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure or verify the company setting that requires approval for every reverse-auction price decrease.; Approve the vendor's pending bid revision with a buyer remark.; Verify rank changes against competing vendors because the prepared state has only one vendor bid.

steps.note: Open the prepared live pricing event's buyer Responses screen as required for this state.
Move to the separate vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared event's live pricing round as Vendor A.
Revise Vendor A's existing bid from 100 to 90 and submit the revision.

args.need: approve Vendor A's pending bid revision with a buyer remark

steps.note: No catalog step performs the buyer approval workflow.
Return to the buyer console after the approval attempt.
Open the buyer's comparison grid to inspect the resulting bid value.
Verify that the approved revised price is shown as 90 in the buyer's grid.
